strategy.action_description: Apply a warp-sliced K-parallel FP4 dequant microkernel to GEMM1/gate-up only. Keep 98a890ad's grouped GEMM2/finalize path unchanged. For qwen_tp2 H=4096 and scale_vec=32, assign one warp or half-warp to a gate/up output pair, have lanes load disjoint 32- or 64-element packed FP4 K chunks with 128-bit loads, decode/apply scales, accumulate partial x1/x2 values, and warp-reduce to one mid[tk,i] store. This changes the FP4 dequant work partitioning, not scheduling or finalization.
strategy.evidence_chain: Profile evidence: 98a890ad's GEMM2 dequant retile passed but remained slow at 1701.344 us, while generation 1's GEMM1 shared-hidden retile also regressed at 1897.984 us; both retained substantial per-output sequential K work. Code evidence: 98a890ad still uses the scalar stage1_activation_kernel, where each thread computes a full H=4096 dot for one intermediate column pair with LUT nibble decode and repeated hidden loads. New reference evidence: gpu-wiki NVFP4 GEMV guidance maps many lanes to one row/dot, uses 128/256-bit FP4 loads, PTX byte decomposition, cache-policy differentiation, and warp/shared reductions to avoid one long K loop per thread; the Hopper hardware table allows high occupancy but no local evidence supports native FP4 tensor cores on this platform. Inference: for T=1/top_k=10, GEMM1 behaves like many tiny software-FP4 GEMVs, so parallelizing K within a dot is a different dequant lever from prior shared-hidden or H-tiled GEMM2 attempts. Action: warp-slice GEMM1 K dequant and reduce within the warp.
strategy.expected_impact: Should increase parallelism in the dominant GEMM1 work, reduce per-thread instruction chains, and make packed FP4 loads more coalesced while leaving the parent grouped down path intact for attribution. It addresses a stage not improved by 98a890ad's GEMM2-only dequantization.
strategy.risks: Warp reductions and two accumulators per output pair can raise register pressure or add shuffle overhead. The first version should specialize only scale_vec==32/H multiple-of-32 qwen_tp2 shapes and fall back to the scalar stage1 path for other shapes. Numerical order changes should remain within the existing bf16 tolerance but need correctness checks.
